## Verdict

Not Ready. This consolidation head has one critical release trust failure, several high-severity data, transport, and filesystem failures, and multiple medium privacy and contract failures. The six review passes cover release and CI, persistence and recovery, native security, frontend and state, cross-platform runtime, and an adversarial cross-domain pass. I posted 17 independent inline blockers on this head. Existing bot threads were treated as leads and were not accepted without a separate reachability and impact check.

The build, lint, unit, integration, and native hosted jobs pass on the reviewed SHA. CodeAnt Quality Gates and SCR currently fail with a rating C and 80 findings. The repository also contains review evidence for a different head and a committed session transcript. Do not merge until the blocker clusters below are fixed, the new head is reverified, and the evidence is regenerated.
